This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off game]] [[Pokémon Shuffle]] for the [[Nintendo 3DS]] (and mobile), per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[The Pokémon Company]] and developed by [[Genius Sonority]].

This list includes staff teams for both the Nintendo 3DS and mobile versions.
